data.name: sites-cloud-ocr.yml
data.text:
name: Sites cloud OCR

on:
  schedule:
    # Equivalent minutes 7,22,37,52. Refresh cron registration after an
    # observed scheduling gap; a future actual scheduled run is still needed.
    - cron: '7/15 * * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:
  workflow_run:
    workflows: [Payment control checks]
    types: [completed]
    branches: [main]

# Only reviewed default-branch code may receive the OCR credential. Resume the
# durable queue after successful checks of the exact current main commit too;
# the external periodic schedule may be delayed. Keep existing activation.
permissions:
  contents: read
concurrency:
  group: sites-cloud-ocr
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  ocr:
    if: >-
      github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && vars.MG_CLOUD_OCR_ENABLED == 'true' &&
      (github.event_name != 'workflow_run' ||
      (github.event.workflow_run.conclusion == 'success' &&
      github.event.workflow_run.event == 'push' &&
      github.event.workflow_run.head_branch == 'main' &&
      github.event.workflow_run.head_repository.full_name == github.repository &&
      github.event.workflow_run.head_sha == github.sha))
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
      - name: Verify reviewed main before dependency installation
        run: node scripts/verify-cloud-ocr-trigger.mjs
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
      - name: Install locked OCR dependencies
        run: npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund
      - name: Recheck current main before OCR credential use
        run: node scripts/verify-cloud-ocr-trigger.mjs
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
      - name: Process at most six leased documents
        run: node scripts/run-sites-cloud-ocr.mjs
        env:
          MG_SITES_ORIGIN: ${{ vars.MG_SITES_ORIGIN || secrets.MG_SITES_ORIGIN }}
          MG_SITES_OCR_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.MG_SITES_OCR_TOKEN }}
